main_text.p: Dominus confistebat; conscenditque adhibito secum Aaron, Nabad & Abiud, majoribus natu septuaginta. Sed hi nona Vulg. vocentes Dominum intueri, locum tamen, in quo Dominus stabat, viderunt; cujus mirabilis forma & claritudo eximia referetur.

Moyses autem accersitus a Domino, interiore nube, quæ circum Dominum fleterat, ingressus, quadraginta diebus totidemque noctibus ibi fuisse traditur. Quo temporeExod. 24. super ædificando tabernaculo atque arca, rituque sacrificandi edoctus verbis Dei est,26. 27. 28. 29. 30.

Quæ ego, quia prolixa admodum videbantur, inferenda huic tam præcisio operi non putaui. Sed immorate diutius Moyse, quippe qui XL. dies apud Dominum duceret, populus desperato ejus reditu, Aaron compulit simulacra facere. TuncExod. 32. ex metallis conflatis vituli caput extitit.Vitulia.rei adv. Cui cum populus, Domini immemor, holocausta obtulisset, vinoque & vetri dediitet, despectas hæc justo dolore Deus, improbum populum, nisi a Moyse fuisset exoratus, deleret. Sed regressus Moyses, cum duas ex lapide tabulas manu Domini scriptas detulisset, populumque luxui & sacrilegio dedito deprehendisset, tabulas confregit: in-ratio.

page.notes: Marginal notes are small and only partly legible on the scan; the right-margin items were read approximately and are marked as doubtful. Several words in the body (for example "non" at the end of the first line group, "fuisse", "holocausta") were not clear and should be checked against the scan. The line "dignam" appears as a broken-off final word at the bottom and may continue on the next page. Scan is slightly skewed; some lines are faint. The sentence running over the column ends at "in-dignam" with a hyphen.
